title: What Body-Heat Power Wearables Is
definition: Body-Heat Power Wearables: wearables powered by the wearer's own heat.
description:
Body-Heat Power Wearables is wearables powered by the wearer's own heat. It sits squarely in Future Energy Systems, the frontier where TEG modules science becomes wearable logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are trickle charging-scale. Societies that master wearable hulls early will shape comfort design practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why TEG modules programs worldwide now treat Body-Heat Power Wearables as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Body-Heat Power Wearables needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Body-Heat Power Wearables
title: Real Research Today: Body-Heat Power Wearables
definition: Today's documented research behind Body-Heat Power Wearables.
description:
The road to Body-Heat Power Wearables is already being paved. Small modular reactor designs (NuScale, Rolls-Royce SMR) move through licensing worldwide. Perovskite solar cells have passed 33% tandem efficiency in laboratory records.

ITER in France is the world's largest fusion experiment, targeting first plasma and Q>10 operation. Together these programs form the TEG modules foundation that Body-Heat Power Wearables will build on — the wearable logistics results, the comfort design methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as wearable logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: 2032 — First commercial wearable hulls plant sells TEG modules power to
definition: 2032 milestone on the Body-Heat Power Wearables roadmap.
description:
First commercial wearable hulls plant sells TEG modules power to the grid under a 20-year trickle charging contract.

What must be true first: the TEG modules results have to replicate outside the lab, wearable logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and comfort design operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed TEG modules demonstrations, wearable logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting comfort design uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Body-Heat Power Wearables
definition: Estimates Body-Heat Power Wearables readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Body-Heat Power Wearables components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a wearable hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Body-Heat Power Wearables Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Body-Heat Power Wearables operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Body-Heat Power Wearables installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 56606 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where TEG modules monitoring, wearable logistics redundancy, or comfort design maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Body-Heat Power Wearables Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Body-Heat Power Wearables: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Body-Heat Power Wearables — wearables powered by the wearer's own heat.

Phase 1 — Prove (TEG modules): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (wearable logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (comfort design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (trickle charging): wearable hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and consumers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
